authority.instruction: the lid on the small box can be optional

decision: A lid is optional. Confirm the open or lidded version with the teacher and record it before stock planning.

application.stock: Sides and bottom for an open box; include top/lid stock only if selected.
application.lid_and_hinges: Lid chamfers apply only to the selected and specified lid. Small hinges are teacher supplied or teacher approved only where the approved version uses them.
application.open_box_evidence: Record the approved lid-free choice and observable opening, edge condition, access, stability and finish checks. Lid and hinge evidence is not required for an open box.
application.learning: All students may answer conditional lid theory questions; personal practical and folio evidence must describe the version actually made.
application.unchanged_authority: The approved local sources and teacher direction continue to control dimensions, joints, tolerances, practical procedures, finish, assessment arrangements and permission.

supersedes: Mandatory-lid wording in earlier programme documents, the three module presentations and alignment manifests. This amendment changes that requirement only; it does not approve a new construction method.
